# BLO-58502 — fstat the open handle in `tailPodLogFile`

[BLO-58502](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-58502), PR
[#3857](https://github.com/Blockcast/paperclip/pull/3857).
Files: `src/server/execute.ts` (+3/−2).

The poll loop in `tailPodLogFile` called `fs.stat(filePath)` on every
iteration (every 250 ms, or 1 s once idle) for every live run, although the
file handle was already open. It now calls `handle.stat()` (fstat) instead.

## Why

Worker stall profiles on paperclip-1 (2026-11-20) showed `stat` under
`tailPodLogFile` as the top self-time frame, at 200–1595 ms per profile. Each
path stat is a CephFS path lookup against the shared MDS. An fstat on the open
handle returns the same size with no path walk.

## Behaviour

Unchanged. The read logic and the final 5 s drain loop are untouched. The
drain still path-stats, on purpose, for the CephFS metadata-lag reason given
in its comment. If the file is replaced at the path while the run is live, the
loop now follows the open inode rather than the new path. The old code read
through that same handle anyway, so it already followed the old inode.
